column1: # ARTIFACT-V0-008 declared permission exceptions (V1-1469), read by script/check-ci-least-privilege.sh
# from the Git index. Every other workflow-level or job-level `permissions:` block in
# .github/workflows/*.yml must be exactly `contents: read`. One row per block, tab-separated:
# workflow, block (`workflow` or `job:<id>`), the exact permission set as space-separated
# scope:level tokens, and the reason. A row that matches no block fails the check.

column4: SOP-V0-013: comments on or opens the nightly-triage issue after a failed scheduled run on main; runs only .github/nightly-signal from the scheduled commit; pinned by TestSOPV0013WorkflowBinding
AFP-V0-016/026: workflow_run from the default branch posts the ci-control-plane status on the PR head or merge-queue commit; reads PR metadata only, never checks out PR code
AFP-V0-047: reads completed CI run artifacts to record forward rows; read-only, posts no status
AFP-V0-163: a merge-queue entry reads the jobs listing and the artifact-integrity-record job log of the pull-request run that verified its tree; read-only, the token reaches only the reuse step
